candidates.change_summary: Replace increment of imBalances[to] by creditsIssued with increment by mAssetAmount, causing stored credits to reflect input mAsset amount instead of savings' credits.
Replace increment of imBalances[to] by creditsIssued with decrement by creditsIssued, causing imBalances to decrease rather than increase when supplying.
Replace the call to savings.depositSavings(...) with savings.depositSavings(mAssetAmount, msg.sender) (using caller as beneficiary), which may change creditsIssued and thus imBalances[to].

Move the imBalances update to occur before calling savings.depositSavings, so imBalances is updated using an uninitialized creditsIssued (0) then deposit affects external state but not the recorded credits.
Replace the nonReentrant modifier behavior to not set _status to ENTERED before the function body, allowing reentrancy and potentially causing different imBalances after supplyTokenTo.
